welcome.title: From a task to a result you can trust.
welcome.lede: Use agents in your local repositories. Keep tickets, notes, code, and evidence together so you can pick up where you left off.
welcome.openRepositoryHint: Choose a folder on your computer. You can connect Jira or Crane later.

outcome.body: A task can be a code change, an investigation, or a document. Choose your agent when you start.

together.body: A workspace holds your tasks, files, and terminals. Keep goals, decisions, and evidence in Information. Use a separate worktree when changes need isolation.

review.body: Fleet shows work that needs your attention. Open a task to review results and checks, then request changes or take the next action.

welcome.accountsHint: Stave uses the Claude and Codex sign-ins on this computer. To add another, open <link>account settings</link>.

executionControls.heading: Workspace execution
executionControls.description: Stop terminals and managed services without removing the workspace. Running tasks and scripts must finish first. The stop lasts until you resume or the runtime restarts.
executionControls.confirmBody: Terminal commands and managed services in {{name}} will end. Unsaved state inside those processes may be lost. Code files, conversations and tabs stay available.

messages.stopped: Execution stopped. Code, conversations and tabs are kept. Lens pages use their separate sleep and release controls.
messages.allowed: Execution allowed. Open a terminal or run a task to start again; previous commands are not rerun.

template.title: Collection template

clearDialog.description: This applies only to this repository and cannot be undone here. Older turns and pending automatic collection will not refill cleared memories. Content already sent to an ongoing conversation remains there. Collection settings are kept.
